**turkushan-auth**: a self-hosted login portal (forward auth) for Nginx Proxy Manager.
Users register their own account, and you approve per site who gets in. One login works across all your subdomains. Everything runs in one container with a built-in SQLite database.
Support and bug reports: [GitHub issues](https://github.com/turkushan490/turkushan-auth/issues).
